info.title: API.SH: Peek & Cloppenburg
info.description: The Peek & Cloppenburg API from API.SH: public Peek & Cloppenburg data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Live stock per size of one product (one colour): each size's SKU, price, ISO currency, stock level (in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock), quantity and whether it can be ordered online; with `store`, that store's stock per size too.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Peek & Cloppenburg product link, or a product id (the number at the end of the link, one id per colour).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Shop: de (default, peek-cloppenburg.de), at (peek-cloppenburg.at), nl or pl. Prices are in the shop's currency (EUR; PLN for pl). Peek & Cloppenburg has no online shop in Switzerland. `country` is accepted as the same thing; a link's own shop is used when a link is given.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Also the stock in this store (store id from /peek-cloppenburg/v1/stores).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The shop's category tree (women, men, kids and every level below) with each category's id, name, path, link and product count. `parent` returns one branch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-categories

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Shop: de (default, peek-cloppenburg.de), at (peek-cloppenburg.at), nl or pl. Prices are in the shop's currency (EUR; PLN for pl). Peek & Cloppenburg has no online shop in Switzerland. `country` is accepted as the same thing; a link's own shop is used when a link is given.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Only this category's children (id or path, e.g. /herren/bekleidung).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Levels to return (default all, max 8).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one shop category, with the same product fields, filters, sort and paging as search. Pass a category id or path from /peek-cloppenburg/v1/categories (e.g. /damen/bekleidung/maentel) or a shop category link; a link's brand part (…/brand-comma) becomes a brand filter. Page with `page` (`next_page`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id or path from /peek-cloppenburg/v1/categories, or a shop category link.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Shop: de (default, peek-cloppenburg.de), at (peek-cloppenburg.at), nl or pl. Prices are in the shop's currency (EUR; PLN for pl). Peek & Cloppenburg has no online shop in Switzerland. `country` is accepted as the same thing; a link's own shop is used when a link is given.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, sale (biggest reduction first), bestselling, popularity.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand filter, comma = any of (brand slugs as in `brand_slug` or `facets.brand`, e.g. comma, levis, boss).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour filter, comma = any of (black, blue, beige, brown, grey, green, white, red, pink, ...; values in `facets.colorGroup`).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter, comma = any of: 38, M, 30/32 (jeans width/length), 42.5 (shoes), or a size code from `facets.sizeCodeV2` such as kg_38.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material filter (wool, cotton, cashmere, linen, leather, ...; values in `facets.materials`).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: women, men or kids.

parameters.name: sale
parameters.description: true: reduced items only; false: full price only.

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: true: new items only.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Only items stocked in that store (store id from /peek-cloppenburg/v1/stores, e.g. 290).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: winter, sommer or ganzjahr.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other filter as name:value;name:value (several values of one name joined by |), names and values from `facets` (e.g. pattern:checked;flags-premium:True).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page (default 48, max 200).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product (one colour) as its page shows it: product id, style id, name, brand, colour and colour groups, every size with its SKU, price, price before discount, lowest price of the last 30 days, ISO currency, stock level and quantity, the other colours with their ids and links, description and bullet points, materials, care, model size, season, category and breadcrumbs, review figures (count, size and fit ratings), badges, images and videos, shop-the-look items and the manufacturer.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-product

get.description:
Search a Peek & Cloppenburg shop (Germany, Austria, Netherlands, Poland): every product (one per colour) with its id and style id, brand, the price and the price before discount with ISO currency, the lowest price of the last 30 days, every size with its SKU, price and whether it can be ordered online, colour group, the other colour ids, categories, materials, badges and images, plus the shop's filters with counts (`facets`) and the matching categories. The shop's sort and every filter it offers. Page with `page` (`next_page`, null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-search

get.description:
Stock of one product (one colour) per size in a store, or in the stores nearest a postal code, city or point: quantity on the sales floor, in the stockroom and in outer storage, reserved and reservable pieces, availability, price and ISO currency per size, with the store's address and opening hours.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-store-stock

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Peek & Cloppenburg product link, or a product id (the number at the end of the link, one id per colour).

parameters.description: Shop: de (default, peek-cloppenburg.de), at (peek-cloppenburg.at), nl or pl. Prices are in the shop's currency (EUR; PLN for pl). Peek & Cloppenburg has no online shop in Switzerland. `country` is accepted as the same thing; a link's own shop is used when a link is given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Nearest stores to check (default 3, max 8).

get.description:
The shop country's Peek & Cloppenburg stores: id, name, address, coordinates, phone, opening hours per weekday and special opening days, services and photos. With `zip`, `city` or `lat`/`lng` they come nearest first with the distance in km. `market=ch` lists the Swiss store (Peek & Cloppenburg has no Swiss web shop).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peek-cloppenburg-stores

parameters.name: city

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
